replacements.Evaluación online progresiva desde shado: Progressive online evaluation from shadow to experiment and rollout
replacements.Cada etapa online compra una evidencia d: Each online stage buys different evidence
replacements.Shadow observa al candidato sin servir s: Shadow observes the candidate without serving its response; canary grants limited real exposure; A/B randomizes when causal effect is the question. Hard guardrails can abort even when the product metric improves.
replacements.Diagrama desplazable de shadow, canary,: Scrollable diagram of shadow, canary, A/B, and the regression gate
replacements.Etapas de evaluación online y decisiones: Online evaluation stages and release decisions
replacements.Una identidad de candidato pasa por regr: A candidate identity passes through offline regression, shadow without response authority, canary with limited real exposure, and an A/B experiment when causal effect is required. Shadow, canary, A/B, and guardrails send evidence to a release gate that can promote, pause, or roll back.
replacements.1 · AUMENTA EXPOSICIÓN SÓLO CUANDO CAMBI: 1 · INCREASE EXPOSURE ONLY WHEN THE QUESTION CHANGES
replacements.3 · EL RELEASE GATE COMPONE EVIDENCIA Y: 3 · THE RELEASE GATE COMPOSES EVIDENCE AND RISK
replacements.shadow, canary y A/B no son tres intensi: shadow, canary, and A/B are not three intensities of the same test. They change who sees the output, which side effects are allowed, and what conclusion you can defend. A serious release gate preserves that distinction and provides an explicit path for inconclusive evidence.
